label: BRAT v2.0+ stores token names in data.json and token values in Obsidian SecretStorage.
Legacy token migration uses brat-gh-global and normalized brat-gh-{owner}-{repo} SecretStorage names, with deduplication and migration logging.
Per-repo tokenName overrides globalTokenName for install/update; missing secrets warn but leave tokenValue empty.
Authenticated GitHub release/API requests use Authorization: Token when a token value is available.
Token validation checks supported prefixes, token shape, expiration, scopes/permissions, rate limits, and optional repository access.
Settings UI uses SecretComponent and flags configured-but-missing per-repo secrets in the beta plugin list.
Official docs call private repo support experimental and recommend fine-grained repository-scoped read-only tokens; release notes clarify SecretStorage values are device-local.
